newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks close lower on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks close lower on profit-taking.

text.p: Sri lanka stocks closed down on Tuesday, led by retail profit-taking, brokers said.
The all share index closed 6.61 points down at 739.8. Price declines led gains by 46 to 19. Ceylinco Insurance fell 1.25 rupees to 22.50, Development Finance one to 279.
"Profit-taking, led by retailers, will probably bring the all share down to about 720 points before the index starts picking up again," said Subram Ramasamy of Bartleet Mallory Stock Brokers.
